subject.title: fix(security): add estimate-before-decode guard to base64 paths

question: Should `@openclaw/media-core/base64-size-limit` become a supported exported package contract for bundled and external consumers, or should the limiter remain private to the owning image/CLI implementation?
rationale: The new export map, path aliases, and barrel re-export create a durable package boundary; repository policy requires maintainer-visible direction for compatibility-sensitive plugin/package APIs.

options.title: Keep the limiter private
options.body: Move or inline the helper behind the existing owning implementation boundary so the security repair does not add a new package contract.

options.title: Approve the media-core export
options.body: Retain the subpath export with an explicit compatibility owner, contract rationale, and focused consumer coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep the limiter private
recommendation.body: Move or inline the helper behind the existing owning implementation boundary so the security repair does not add a new package contract.
